findings.remediation_advice: Replace os.system() with subprocess.run() using shell=False and argument arrays.

findings.title: Dynamic Code Execution via eval()
findings.remediation_advice: Eliminate eval(); replace with safe expression evaluator or dispatcher.

findings.remediation_advice: Use safe structured serialization formats like JSON or Protocol Buffers.

findings.remediation_advice: Avoid dynamic evaluation or unsanitized innerHTML assignments.
